name: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Protection Potion
objectiveText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction. Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Protection Potion  ( 1 ) Shadow Protection Potion  ( 1 )

comments.body:
The quest item dropped for me from a harpy in the Dry Hills in the Barrens on Sept. 23rd 2026. 

I could not see the delivery location until I obtained the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=7256/shadow-protection-potion]Shadow Protection Potion[/url] and turned on quest tracking in the quest log. 

The NPC to turn in the quest was [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=3134/kzixx]Kzixx [/url]in Duskwood, rewards were 75 rep with Durotar Supply and Logistics and 28s 42c from the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=284583/coin-pouch]Coin Pouch[/url].
